text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Due to Nakayama Racecourse being under construction, this year's Satsuki Sho will be held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The ground is trembling.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Both the vibrations I feel seeping through my cleats and the electric energy pervading the air are born from the spectators gathered here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So this is how heated a Classic Triple Crown race can be…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh, to think that the day would come that I would be racing in the Satsuki Sho…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (I never even dreamt of such a future when I was young…)

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Aaargh! How dare they say that to me! How dare they, how dare they, how dare they?!

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… I can't get angry… Water still, water still… Tame the blaze fierce with water still…

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Waaah! I can't do it! Raaaaah! I'm so mad and angry and—

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: AAAUGHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud, thud, thud!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yaeno. What did I teach you to do when you're angry?

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Hngh… Yah! Yah! Yah! Yah! I'm so mad! I'm so mad! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Very good. Channel the anger into your fists. Follow the path of your rage, and release it bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: As long as you're practicing katas, you may swing and throw your fists to your heart's content, until you are at peace with your emotions.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Have you calmed down? Now you must reflect. What is it that made you so angry?

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno
text_block_list.text: It was that bully! He said such mean things! But… I was the one who started it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: It appears you've realized what you've done wrong. Now that you know, you must right it. You must learn to think before your anger takes hold of you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (It took a very long time before I learned how to contain my fierce blaze.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (If Grampa hadn't been there to accept and guide me, I would still be walking the wrong path in life.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I want to repay my debt to Grampa…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have to claim victory on this prestigious stage and show him how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Victory shall be mine!
choice_data_list: Yeah, bring home the trophy for your grandfather!
Yeah, bring home the trophy for your grandfather!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Osu! I'll be off!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, ready for battle!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she looks super fired up! Let's see… Looks like her name's Yaeno Muteki. I wonder if she's any good?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Sigh. If only she was racing today! It's too bad she had to sit out because of an injury. She definitely would've been the favorite.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hey, but Sakura Chiyono O is running and she beat your fave! I'm pretty sure she's gonna be the one to win today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale… Exhale…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (…Don't let it bother you. Focus on yourself!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Yaeno Muteki's got something real unique about her!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's not just her clothes, either. That martial arts-looking pose she just did was so dignified and cool!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno's so focused!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's some gigantic force surging out of her in huge waves! I can feel it from here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can't just match her energy—I have to beat it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who's going to win here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno… Chiyono O…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: How vexing… I wish I could be out there in the fray as well, pitting my will against yours!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But… for the sake of the upcoming Japanese Derby…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I must stay back and just bear witness to your race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The blaze fierce and waters still are now as one.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll show everyone I can control the roaring flames in my heart!
